summary.text: Joe Berning is the Democratic candidate for Illinois State Senate District 45 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Andrew Chesney. A salesman and consultant from the Galena area, he grew up on a dairy and hog farm.

paragraphs.text: Berning attended the University of Wisconsin, Platteville.
His career experience includes working as a district sales manager for a Fortune 500 company and for Prudential Insurance Company, and as owner and operator of JB Consulting.
He has been affiliated with the Roman Catholic Church, the NAACP, Future Farmers of America, Jo Daviess County Democrats and the Lions Club.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Berning said he has lived in the rural Galena area of Jo Daviess County his whole life and has been married for 45 years.
He said he intends to represent all voters in the district regardless of party, to help family farms, and to address affordability for lower- and middle-income families.
